correctness.rationale: Exact sum-zero left eigenspace guarantees the bright-weight factorization. An exact parity block reduction yields one even eigenvalue equal to 1 and a near-1 odd eigenvalue with splitting 2/n²+O(n^-3). Nonbridge weights of top eigenvectors are 1-O(1/n); two-by-two spectral projectors bound the right amplitude error by 2n/(n-1)² and right bridge probability by 4n/(n-1)², establishing the 8n/(n-1)² uniform-in-time probability error. Sharp times, arbitrary-packet preparation iff criterion and first fixed-threshold time then follow rigorously. 482 replayable finite checks corroborate, not replace, the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A single-edge bottleneck in the same physical graph allows near-unit coherent packet transport but suppresses every single-vertex launch to O(1/n). The exact packet overlap is a complete preparation obstruction and the n² beat timescale is sharp with a measurable first-threshold limit; the all-time bound holds beyond perturbative fixed-time expansions. These resolve a motivated transport-vs-localization question left open by IPR-based observations, rather than computing an arbitrary graph constant.
